li.label: a little satisfaction
li.description: I saw someone I resent have a bad moment. I kept my satisfaction to myself.

li.label: taken down a peg
li.description: After everything between us, seeing them stumble felt satisfying. That does not mean they deserved it.

li.label: an uncomfortable flicker of pleasure
li.description: Part of me enjoyed seeing them struggle. Another part wishes I had not.

li.label: that felt unkind
li.description: I dislike them, but what I saw was painful. My moment of satisfaction does not sit comfortably with me.
